title: Dev Log #33: Every river finds its way downhill
summary: The new water now runs through all eleven regions, and the land along every creek and river was cut so the water always flows one way and can always be seen. The four women also got all twelve outfits rebuilt, with real capes, fitted gowns and period footwear.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #32: Rivers that move, and creeks you can wade
summary: The river and creek look was rebuilt and approved, starting where the Rea Brook meets the Severn. Every river in the test area is filled, the player can wade in, the live water simulation now costs 0.04 ms per frame, and the ground under the water is real creek bed.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #31: Ten regions rebuilt, and the rivers start over
summary: All ten region maps around the hub were rebuilt overnight from real elevation data, each with its own biome map and our own plants. The hub got the approved planting, and the rivers were cleared and restarted from one test stretch where the Rea Brook meets the Severn.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #30: Every region gets its own plants, and the seasons turn
summary: All 99 hand-built plant sets are now assigned across the 11 regions, and every region has plants found nowhere else. One switch now turns every plant through spring, summer, autumn and winter, and the environment test map was rebuilt with only our own plants.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #29: All 201 clips generated
summary: One overnight run generated all 201 clips of the female movement set across seven weapon sets. Six sets are cut and checked: 149 clips pass, 14 are flagged for another pass, and a first arm pass has run on 153 clips.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #28: The women start to move
summary: The female body gets its own movement set: 201 clips across seven weapon sets, generated fresh for her build and scaled to her stride. The sword and the sword and shield sets are cut into loops and checked, and generation for the rest is running.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #27: Five million plants, crop strips and kitchen gardens
summary: A test copy of the hub now carries over five million plants placed by script across ten biomes, from grazed pasture and hay meadow to reed beds and bluebell woods. Fields hold strips of spelt, rye, barley, oats, peas, beans and flax, the manor has kitchen gardens, and a bug that turned leaves black is fixed project wide.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #26: An ash sky, horses and life on the road
summary: The hub now sits under a volcanic ash sky with drifting black cloud, a red sun, rare lightning and a red moon. A design session set new map scale rules, brought horse riding into the game, and planned tree felling, spear fishing, hunting, road events and paired combat animation.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #25: Four women, twelve outfits and cloth that swings
summary: Four female heads are built on the new body with face rigs, skin, hair and eyelashes. Twelve outfits follow, every cloak and shawl now simulates as cloth in Unreal, a woman in a riding outfit is the test player and character parts now change detail together.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #24: A female base body and a heavier grip
summary: A new healthy female base body is built, reduced to 25,000 triangles, rigged and textured, with four levels of detail and the shared neck seam. The large male body now holds swords, axes, spears and shields on its own sockets, and a see-through ring on two sword pommels is fixed.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #23: Firelight, earthworks and the first trees
summary: The manor buildings are furnished and lit, with flickering fires and doors that open. The palisade sits on a bank and ditch with a walkway, the first oak, ash and alder trees are planted, the rivers have flowing water and the hub streams by distance.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #22: A village from kit pieces
summary: Buildings now come from shared kit pieces on one grid: timber and daub, palisade, build stages and reused Roman stone. Sixteen buildings are in Unreal as level instances, with weathered, snow, burned, charred and rotten states.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #21: Arms that carry their weight
summary: A full arm pass on every movement clip: fists, free wrists, square shoulders, leg-driven arm swing and a carried bow. The approved set is now in the game with walk and run, a guard walk on right mouse, and hidden dismemberment seams.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #20: From motion library to fighting stance
summary: All 883 generated clips retargeted into Unreal, put back on the ground and reviewed in a new editor level, with a sword and shield guard, one-cycle loops and a first pass over every weapon set.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #19: A motion library written in plain English
summary: 865 combat and movement animations for the player, allies, four undead bodies and brigands, generated locally from plain-English descriptions and audited clip by clip.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #18: Combat prototype, real terrain and hair level of detail
summary: A first playable combat system in C++, ten regions rebuilt from real elevation and river data, and hair level of detail for 15 heroes imported into Unreal.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #16: Hair caps under review
summary: Five of fifteen hair caps approved, new scalp, neck and silhouette rules, and a triangle budget for every cap.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #17: Outfits, cloaks and textured hair for the whole cast
summary: A shared garment kit, casual and work outfits for 15 characters, physics cloaks, hidden under-layers and a new hair method.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #14: Lighter characters, same faces
summary: Textured hair and beard shells, reduced bodies and heads, and a typical character cut from about 93,000 to about 45,000 triangles.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #15: Hands, ears, and the review pass
summary: A wrist texture fix on both male bodies, new hair rules around the ears, and a ten-step review checklist for every hero.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #12: Every head is Unreal-ready, Geraint and Custennin, eyelashes, and a live link to the editor
summary: Eight heads packaged for Unreal Engine, Geraint complete, Custennin's face widened, eyelashes on every head, an armpit fix on the standard body, and Unreal connected to Claude.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #13: Seven new faces, and nine characters standing in Unreal
summary: Seven more heads built overnight, and nine characters running the unarmed animation set in Unreal on skeletons rebuilt to match the mannequin.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #11: Cynan complete, Einion Goch's head, and shared rules for every head
summary: Cynan finished and bound to the skeleton, Einion Goch's face rig built, and new rules to keep every head interchangeable.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #10: The opening cinematic, two more heads, and the full armoury
summary: The Chronicle opening cinematic, Iddon and Brother Tysilio complete, Cynan in progress, and studio renders of all 31 arms and armour packages.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #9: Bedwyr and Cadoc complete, Owain textured
summary: Two heads finished with 52 facial shapes each, Owain's face and hair approved, and a new large male body for the smith.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #8: Sir Bedwyr
summary: The first named character head on the new pipeline: seam fit, expressive topology, skin, long grey hair and beard, and a face rig.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #7: Tools of the manor
summary: Sickle, billhook, work axe and spade, each in new, worn and mended states, plus a pipeline for swapping heads on shared bodies.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #6: The design set and eleven heightmaps
summary: The screenplay, character bible, economy design and world plan are written, and every region now has a 16-bit heightmap with terrain masks.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #5: The armoury
summary: Longsword, battle axe, mace, pike, shortsword, double axe and the Grendel Slayer: eight game-ready weapon assets with collision, sockets and 2K to 4K textures.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #4: Building the hero
summary: HERO1, the 1.93 m body behind Owain: hands, face shapes, four hairstyles and a skeleton baked to the Unreal bind pose.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #3: The first humans of a hungry manor
summary: Peasant bodies, layered period clothing, swappable hair and a dynamic dirt, wet and gore material for the folk of the manor.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #2: Undead twins and the Uld woman
summary: Two methods for making characters: a clean rebuild, and a fast conform that reuses a finished model's topology, UVs and rig.
author: KSUIE_Gaming

title: Dev Log #1: The first Uld runs in Unreal Engine 5
summary: Our first character made the full trip from Blender to UE 5.8: rigged, physics-driven hair and clothing, and retargeted animation.
author: KSUIE_Gaming
